purpose: Compare interaction formats for psychological-assessment research prototypes without claiming diagnostic or validated-score equivalence.

pcl5.label: PCL-5
pcl5.source_status: public-domain source instrument; Chinese wording in this repo is prototype paraphrase
pcl5.response_instruction: keep one worst/stressful experience in mind; rate how much each problem bothered the participant in the past month

cape15.label: Current CAPE-P15
cape15.source_status: construct-based prototype paraphrase; not a validated Chinese version
cape15.distress_layer: implemented for core-item modes when frequency >= 1

vassip.research_role: gamified self-report; core items/response format preserved

update_when: item count or response encoding changes

mode_taxonomy.policy: single-axis taxonomy by degree of measurement transformation
mode_taxonomy.mece_scope: MECE within the chosen measurement-transformation axis: no transformation / gamified self-report / transformed scenario-based assessment

psychogat.reason: static fixed-path version lacked defining LLM-agent generation/control/evaluator mechanisms and overlapped the SJT arm

emoji_game.role: optional adherence mechanic for future EMA/factorial studies
emoji_game.reason: orthogonal engagement mechanic rather than a distinct measurement form

mode_quality.vassip_microtask: construct-neutral gamified wrapper; core self-report items retained
mode_quality.rush: scenario-based transformed assessment; single-construct scenes; no item-level feedback
mode_quality.psychogat: disabled until a faithful LLM-agent implementation exists
